_note: Grade 2 vowels (English literacy year, Part 12.3; types/_shared/vowels-g2.js; written by s-g2vow/bank.js). General American pronunciation; one-syllable words except the er list of G2-534 (it also holds two-syllable words that end in er). `pics`: the library picture of a word (looked at on contact sheets; only pictures a second grader names with that word). `printOnly`: pictures a child names another way (none of them is in `pics`). `shortlong` (G2-530): short and long words (simple for Level 1, hard with blends and digraphs), `pairs` of a short word and the same word with a silent e or a vowel team, the pictured words of the pairs, the pictured words to write, the `odd` words of Level 3 (neither short nor long, to cross out), and `sentences` that only one word of a pair fits. `teams` (G2-531): the six vowel teams for long a, e, o; the rule of the place for ai/ay and oa/ow; `gapE`, the only ee and ea words a gap may stand in (no rule tells the two apart); pictured words to write; sentences to finish from a word box; `fillers` that fit no sentence. `diph` (G2-532): oo (moon and book sounds), ou, ow, oi, oy; `notSort` (never sorted by the sound of oo: hoop); `oyGap` (the oy words a gap may stand in); rules; pictures; pair sentences for the two sounds of oo; box sentences; fillers. `aror` (G2-533): ar and or words (no w before or), the pictures to match and their printed decoys, sentences of an ar word and the same word without r (Level 1), of an ar word and an or word (Level 2), box sentences and fillers (Level 3). `erirur` (G2-534): er, ir, ur words, the `keywords` of the instruction (her, first, turn: never an answer), the odd words that have the letters but not the sound, the check task (two wrong spellings that are no words), pictures to write, sentences. Every sentence names in `fits` every other word of its type's lists that also fits the gap; such a word is never printed on a page that shows the sentence. `real`: every real word a gap can build with another offered spelling (from the 50k OpenSubtitles list minus names and junk); `bad` and `badFragments`: words a gap may never build and letters that may never stand beside a gap.
